title: Vail
sourceLines: -1. Hangings used in the tabernacle to separate the Holy of Holies (the Most Holy Place) from the Holy Place
-2. A covering for the ark of the covenant Ex 35:12; 39:34; 40:21; Nu 4:5
.Torn from the top to the bottom at the time of the crucifixion of Jesus Mt 27:51; Mr 15:38; Lu 23:45
